summary: Easier copying of identifiers and better inquiry reassignment.

updates.title: Copyable Identifiers
updates.body: SP ID, NPI, Hub ID, DEA and other identifiers can now be selected and copied across Patient Tracking, Patient Profile and Directory.

updates.title: Flexible HCP and HCO Setup
updates.body: Affiliated HCO is now optional when creating or editing an HCP.

updates.title: Interaction Participants
updates.body: Fixed custom HCP participants displaying as Contact participants.

updates.title: Notes Access for PAL Users
updates.body: PAL users can now create and view notes for consented patients only, and cannot create or view notes for non-consented patients.
